title: 第23章 超级巨款第24章 走大运
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
那可是一个季度的钱，三百多块钱呢。
苏灿有些后悔，毕竟等陆战东回去后，钱的地方可多著呢。
看著她著急的样子，陆战东声音淡淡地：“你看看你的包袱里，是不是多了一样东西？”
苏灿一愣，纳闷地看了看他，接著拿过小包袱检查了一下。
这不检查不要紧，一检查才发现，在叠好的衣服里面竟然多了个信封。
拿出来一看，竟然是一沓钱。
她大体点了一下，竟然是整整两千一百八十块钱。
苏灿一脸惊喜看著他：“这是怎么回事？”
“因为部队之前一直找不到我，所以这个季度的津贴並没有寄回来。今天萧首长来看我，专门带来了这笔钱。所以陆家人领不到。”
“太好了！可是也不至於有这么多钱呀？”
两千一百八十块，这可是一笔超级巨款了。
“这里面有两百块是首长和方局长给我们的结婚红包，还有昨天你交的手术费。因为我要在家里休养半年，所以剩下的是医疗补助和生活补助。”
其实这里面有一千块钱的军功奖，但是陆战东没说。
“哇，那我现在可是大款了。”
苏灿把钱赶紧包好，幸亏这里的病房是个单间，要不然这么多钱被別人看到肯定会眼红的。
她把钱收好，看著他，“你把这么多钱全都给我保管，也不怕我卷钱跑了？”
“不怕。”
苏灿想了想：“那这些钱我可以隨便支配吗？”
“当然。”
“太好了。”

她现在手里至少还有两百多块，那是从杨家离开的时候，跟姜玉容要的。
再加上这两千一百八十块，那就是两千四百块了。
她现在妥妥就是个小富豪了。
如果不是家里还有三个孩子，要考虑以后的生活问题，现在都可以直接在县城买套房子了。
这个年代房价便宜，一千块套几十平的房子了。
但她必须得为这个家的以后打算。
苏灿半开玩笑地道：“要是再有点粮票就好了。”
毕竟这个年代没有粮票买东西都要费很多周折。
“你再找找包里应该有。”
苏灿赶紧翻了翻，发现有个用手帕包起来的一小沓粮票，而且还都是全国通用粮票，苏灿的眼睛顿时亮晶晶的，要知道这可是硬通货。
全国通用呀。
粮票是按照陆战东休假半年来发的，一个月45斤，六个月的时间就是两百七十斤，不过苏灿数完发现给了三百斤的粮票。
“太好了，这下我们买东西不用犯难了。”
真没想到，她竟然又发了一笔小財。
“周大爷和青山还在外面，我出去跟他们说一声。”
content_en:
That's a quarter's worth of money, more than three hundred yuan.
Su Can regretted it a little. After all, there would be plenty of money for Lu Zhandong after he returned.
Seeing her anxious look, Lu Zhandong said in a calm voice: "Look at your baggage, is there something extra?"
Su Can was stunned, looked at him in confusion, then took the small bundle and checked it.
It didn't matter if I didn't check. After checking, I discovered that there was an extra envelope inside the folded clothes.
When I took it out, I saw it was a wad of money.
She roughly clicked it, and it turned out to be a full 2,180 yuan.
Su Can looked at him with surprise: "What's going on?"
"Because the army could not find me before, this quarter's allowance was not sent back. Today Chief Xiao came to see me and brought this money specifically. So the Lu family cannot receive it."
"Great! But you don't have so much money?"
Two thousand one hundred and eighty yuan, this is a huge amount of money.
"Two hundred yuan in it is the wedding red envelope given to us by the chief and Director Fang, as well as the surgery fee you paid yesterday. Because I have to recuperate at home for half a year, the rest is medical subsidies and living allowances."
In fact, there was a military merit award worth 1,000 yuan, but Lu Zhandong didn't mention it.
"Wow, then I'm rich now."
Su Can quickly wrapped the money. Fortunately, the ward here was a single room, otherwise others would be jealous if they saw so much money.
She put the money away and looked at him, "You gave me all this money to keep, and you're not afraid that I'll take it and run away?"
"Not afraid."
Su Can thought for a moment: "Then can I use the money as I please?"
"Of course."
"Great."
She still has at least two hundred yuan in her hand, which she asked for from Jiang Yurong when she left the Yang family.
Add in the two thousand one hundred and eighty yuan, and that's two thousand four hundred yuan.
She is now a little rich man.
If we didn't have three children at home and had to consider future life issues, we could buy a house in the county directly now.
In this era, housing prices are so cheap that a house of dozens of square meters can be purchased for just one thousand yuan.
But she must plan for the future of this family.
Su Can said half-jokingly: "It would be nice if we had more food stamps."
After all, it takes a lot of trouble to buy anything without food stamps in this era.
"You should look for it in your bag again."
Su Can quickly flipped through it and found a small stack of food stamps wrapped in a handkerchief, and they were all national food stamps. Su Can's eyes suddenly lit up, you must know that this was hard currency.
It is applicable nationwide.
Food stamps were given to Lu Zhandong based on his six-month vacation, which was 45 kilograms a month, and two hundred and seventy kilograms in six months. However, after Su Can counted the food stamps, he found that he had been given 300 kilograms of food stamps.
"Great, now we don't have to worry about shopping."
Unexpectedly, she actually made another small fortune.
"Uncle Zhou and Qingshan are still outside. I'll go out and tell them."
